name: datafusion-cli
description: Apache DataFusion CLI — run SQL queries directly against CSV, Parquet, JSON, and Avro files

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install datafusion-cli: cargo install datafusion-cli or brew install datafusion

commands.description: Execute a SQL statement non-interactively (datafusion-cli -c "SQL"; add --format json/csv for machine output)

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install datafusion-cli: cargo install datafusion-cli or brew install datafusion

args.name: sql
args.description: SQL to execute, e.g. CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 'f.parquet'; SELECT * FROM t LIMIT 10

args.name: format
args.description: Output format: table, csv, json, nd-json, arrow, automatic (passed as --format)

args.name: data-path
args.description: Directory to scan for files (passed as --data-path)

commands.description: Execute SQL statements from a .sql file (datafusion-cli -f script.sql)

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install datafusion-cli: cargo install datafusion-cli or brew install datafusion

args.name: script
args.description: Path to a .sql file to execute

commands.description: Open the interactive SQL REPL (optionally over a --data-path directory)
